title: Find Sydney Harbour boating destinations
summary: Use the interactive map to find boating destinations and facilities around Sydney Harbour.

how_to_steps.text: The map is interactive. Select an icon on the map to view the location and facilities at that location.
You can also use the Destination Search drop-down to select a marina.
Go to the Sydney Harbour Boating Destinations Map

external_links.text: Go to the Sydney Harbour Boating Destinations Map

faqs.q: How do I find a boating destination on the map?
faqs.a: You can select an icon on the interactive map to view the location and facilities, or use the Destination Search drop-down to select a marina.

faqs.q: What facilities are available at the boating destinations?
faqs.a: The map shows details on facilities such as dinghy storage, food services, fuel, power, public toilets, pump out area, marine services, and recreational area.

faqs.q: What should I do before I set out boating?
faqs.a: Before setting out, you should contact the marina to confirm berth availability, check the house rules, and know what to do when you arrive at your destination.
